protocol.boundaries: Within-category pooled calibration A/B head predictions only; 7 internal quantiles per head, duplicate cuts collapsed
protocol.policy_class: One arbitrary randomized acceptance probability per error-demand bin and category, shared by all periods
protocol.fitting: No new head fit; calibration outcomes choose probabilities by finite LP
protocol.constraints: For each category separately, A and B excess budgets <=0 and A and B row coverage >=.35; no budget borrowing between categories
protocol.objective: Maximize minimum within-group A/B expected row coverage
protocol.secondary: Cap-only LP (floor0); minimax excess LP at floor.35 with checked dual lower bound
protocol.tie_rule: Deterministic HiGHS solution of the fixed LP, no post-holdout choice
protocol.acceptance: Independent uniform auxiliary variable <= fixed bin probability
protocol.metric_scope: Ratios of conditional expected error/demand sums under randomized acceptance; no realized-mask or finite-sample certificate
